issues.description: The problem asks for the ID, name, art and url of all Freibäder (problem_statement.md) but the reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql) does not select the actual ID column — it aliases the name column as id (SELECT name as id, name, art, url). This both duplicates the name column in the result and violates the problem instruction that students should not rename columns with AS unless requested. Students expecting an actual id column (and following the instruction to avoid AS) could be confused or produce a different, correct result (SELECT id, name, art, url) than the solution demonstrates.
issues.suggested_fix: In the reference solution, select the real id column rather than aliasing name. For example: SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad'. Also remove the unnecessary aliasing/duplicate name column so the solution follows the problem instruction to not use AS unless requested.
